verdict.rationale: Inngest documents an official MCP server page that lets Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or other MCP clients connect to inspect and operate Inngest, and a probe confirms the page exists. The evidence is one summary line, so the depth of the server's capabilities is unproven. Missing for 10: documented tool list and scope of operations, setup and authentication details (local vs hosted endpoint), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
